output.content: I am writing from my usual spot in the deployment logs. Right now, there is no automated link between the raw observability streams and the performance dashboard. I check the service health by hand every morning. I look at the raw error counts in the terminal. I then open the monitoring tool separately. I compare the two sets of numbers by eye. If the error count jumps, I note it in a text file. There is no alert that fires on its own. I do not see a trend line for latency until I manually pull the data. This is the exact sequence I follow today. It is a manual cross check. No code connects the two sides.
